strings.قبل الإغلاق، اطلب تأكيد المسؤول أن فحوص: Before closing, ask the administrator to confirm that the requested service checks have been completed and their locations are documented, and that the ceiling format and settings are supported. Images are useful for the registry, but they do not compensate for the technical check. Record any open note and the name of the administrator, and do not turn it into unclear verbal consent.
strings.بعد التشطيب، راجع استقامة الخطوط وتناسق: After finishing, review the straightness of the lines, the consistency of the edges and the position of the openings with the agreed drawing and sample. Try to reach the maintenance cover in the presence of the administrator, and review the appearance under the lighting used in the room. If a problem arises, describe its location and effect instead of asking the worker for an improvised solution that may change the detail depending on the situation.
